Lina — thanks for the packet. Quick checklist from our side before we mark the vendor active: 

1) Finance (cc Marissa) needs either a micro‑deposit verification (two small deposits from our test) or a bank letter that explicitly authorizes ACH debits. The attached bank letter looks ok but finance will confirm.
2) Can you confirm the exact remittance remap you expect for PO line-items? We prefer one of these two options: a) remittance reference = PO number, b) remittance reference = PO number + invoice line tag. If you have a sample CSV, please attach.
3) Legal asks that the remittance contact email (ap@novaoptics.com) is included as your default remit contact in the vendor record.

If it's easier, Treasury can reply here with the micro‑deposit screenshot and a small sample remit CSV. Once Finance confirms the micro‑deposit or accepts the bank letter, Marissa can flip the vendor to Active and we will send the first PO.

Next steps: Lina/Treasury — send micro‑deposit proof or sample_remit CSV. Marissa/Priyom — will review and update vendor record.
